newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cbank head says full independence a must.
newsitem.headline: Austria cbank head says full independence a must.

text.p: Austrian central bank chief Klaus Liebscher said on Tuesday only full independence for Europe's future central bank could guarantee stable prices, smooth growth and more jobs.

"It is relatively certain, theoretically as well as empirically, that at least in industrial countries there is a strong correlation between a high degree of central bank independence and low inflation rates," he told a banking conference according to an advance copy of his speech.
"Furthermore it is acknowledged that a policy of stable money is the best condition for high employment and stable growth," he added.
